none: PAS YORYM-B3B20F: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy contemporary copy nummus of Constans dating to the period AD 337 - 350 (Reece Period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers and one standard. Mint of Trier. The combination of the obverse legend reading CONSTANS PF AVG and the reverse mint mark TRS does not appear to be recorded in RIC
